subject: Shiny-Server: unable to connect over local network

messages.author: ae9f0997fc617345
messages.subject: Shiny-Server: unable to connect over local network
parts:
Hi,
I have shiny-server up and running.  I can access index.html and the app is running fine (running it as my regular user acct, not root) at http://localhost:3838/appname/.  Moreover, the result of netstat -nlp | grep 3838 is

tcp        0      0 0.0.0.0:3838            0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      5128/shiny-server

which I think is right.  Yet, when we've tried http://ip-address:3838/appname/ (or even /index.html) from other computers on the local network, the connection times out.  I have verified the ip and I can ssh to the machine.

Does anyone have an idea of why I wouldn't be able to connect over the network?  I have been unable to find anyone with a similar problem online.  Thanks in advance.
